line: The yellow kettle sang at dawn, and every window on Marigold Lane woke up to the smell of fresh bread.
about: One entry per speech model the studio knows about. Facts come from each model's card or code, read on 2026-11-01. Proof comes from voice_proof.json, written by scripts/build_voices_page.py from real renders.
measured: Whisper (faster-distil-whisper large-v3 for English, large-v3 for other languages), ffmpeg ebur128 and a peak check. No person has listened.
